findings.kind: native candidate acceptance blocker / evidence limit

findings.trigger: Claiming PR77 proves the manufactured estimator endpoint was handed into WRF and accepted at native first call.
findings.impact: The receipt binds real partialhost experiments, but not the estimator artifact to a WRF input; both native arms reject/fail and candidate/science acceptance are explicitly false.

findings.trigger: A candidate’s dimensions and units validate while variables were derived at different grid locations, eta indices, or from inconsistent derivatives.
findings.impact: The W mapper can produce silently incorrect native W from a dimensionally valid but semantically misaligned payload.
findings.authority_gap: No native increment producer/writer was found under src; consumer checks units/layout/time/grid but not derivative provenance or cross-field consistency. Current fixtures cannot establish actual producer semantics.
findings.next_check: Bind actual candidate generator and document field locations/order/source; independently check pressure/height derivatives and U/V destaggering on an actual payload.

findings.trigger: Compare or combine legacy omega-to-W diagnostic conversions with state-layer/native kinematic W as if they represented one quantity.
findings.impact: Different assumptions (fixed 8 km scale height vs moist density/gravity or native chain-rule mapping) can produce different W interpretations.
findings.authority_gap: No single semantic selector labels all consumers’ W meaning; this may be intentional if diagnostic/native-state contracts are distinct.
findings.next_check: Trace each consumer contract and compare on representative T/Q/P/omega cases before claiming equivalence.

source_trace_result: No static pressure-level/unit conversion defect found in the requested lapsprep→WPS-array path. WPS pressure hPa→Pa; adapter checks pressure-coordinate correspondence. Vapor and six hydrometeor species use dry-air kg/kg. Surface PSFC is Pa, terrain/height is m. SH-to-mixing-ratio, surface MR scaling and hydrometeor dry-density conversion are explicit.
